description: This Java source file defines a Spring Boot REST controller that provides a redirect endpoint for the OpenAPI JSON documentation, ensuring external tooling can access the documentation at a standardized path (/openapi.json) by redirecting to the configured springdoc API docs path.

classes.name: OpenApiDocsController
classes.description: A Spring REST controller that provides an endpoint (/openapi.json) which redirects to the configured OpenAPI documentation URL, facilitating compatibility with external tools.

methods.name: openApiJsonRedirect
methods.description: Handles GET requests to /openapi.json and redirects to the configured API docs path.
methods.outputs: RedirectView object pointing to the API docs path
